integrity: The exact printed facet list is embedded in the standalone verifier. All ten deletions are exhaustively checked with exact rational arithmetic. No claim of independent validation is made.
scientific_limitations: The deletion claim is rational-homology only; it does not determine integral torsion or deletion homotopy types. Noncontractibility of the full complex is taken from the cited primary source, while rational acyclicity and every deletion rank are independently replayed from the printed facets. The preprint date is verified from a public copy reproducing the dated preprint header.
title: Every vertex deletion creates first homology in a ten-vertex acyclic complex
